gloss: high school graduate; high school diploma

definitions.gloss: high school graduate; high school diploma
definitions.explanation: A person who has graduated from high school, or the educational background of having completed high school. An abbreviation of {高校|こうこう}{卒業|そつぎょう}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高卒|こうそつ}だ。
examples.english: He is a high school graduate.

examples.japanese: {高卒|こうそつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people get jobs right after graduating high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高卒|こうそつ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧になっている。
examples.english: The requirement for this job posting is at least a high school diploma.

notes:
Abbreviation of ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧ (high school graduation). Commonly used in job listings and on resumes to indicate educational background.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高卒|こうそつ}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧ — high school diploma or above (job requirement)
- {高卒|こうそつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ — to start working after high school
- {高卒|こうそつ}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ — high school equivalency

- ⟦{中卒|ちゅうそつ}→中卒：11380_chuusotsu⟧ — junior high school graduate
